BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: VII
BRANCH: BIOTECHNOLOGY   SESSION: MO/2018

SUBJECT: BT7033 ANIMAL & STEM CELL TECHNOLOGY

TIME: 1.5 HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q1 (a) List the requirements of a modern animal cell culture laboratory. [2]
 (b) Describe the components of popular media used for animal cell culture. [3]

Q2 (a) Give protocol for suspension of anchorage dependent cells. [2]
 (b) Describe the method for making chick embryo serum. [3]

Q3 (a) Describe the procedure of cell-cell communication by exocytosis and endocytosis. [2]
 (b) With the help of diagrams, differentiate between tight junctions and Desmosomes. [3]

Q4 (a) Describe the largescale culture system of anchorage dependent cells. [2]
 (b) Mention properties of anchorage dependent cells which are associated with anchorage of
cells with glassware.
[3]

Q5 (a) Design a physical method for suspending a monolayer in culture medium. [2]
 (b) Give your strategy for selection of a method for cell line cryopreservation. [3]

Q6 (a) Describe steps of cell line characterization using light microscope. [2]
 (b) Demonstrate a protocol for synchronization of animal cells in culture. [3]
